findings.title: Direct EncryptionClient.init({ strategy }) caller silently loses its auth strategy
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Verified that head init() forwards only config.authStrategy and that the alias is resolved only in Encryption(), so a direct init({strategy}) call falls back silently to ambient credentials.

findings.title: Deprecation console.warn surfaces in production logs for existing `strategy` users
findings.label: trivial
findings.note: The once-per-process console.warn is intended deprecation behaviour, and one extra log line is immaterial.
